```{r}
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
```
```{r}
# On crée un index numérique pour l’axe x
Data_Globale_Tahiti <- Data_Globale_Tahiti %>%
  mutate(x_id = as.numeric(factor(Enr)))

# Dataset pour les rectangles de fond
communes_bg <- Data_Globale_Tahiti %>%
  group_by(Commune) %>%
  summarise(
    xmin = min(x_id) - 0.5,
    xmax = max(x_id) + 0.5
  )

ggplot() +
  # Fond coloré discret
  geom_rect(data = communes_bg,
            aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax,
                ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
                fill = Commune),
            alpha = 0.08) +
  geom_col(data = Data_Globale_Tahiti,
           aes(x = x_id, y = `HSA(%)`),
           fill = "grey40") +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = Data_Globale_Tahiti$x_id,
    labels = Data_Globale_Tahiti$Enr
  ) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Paired") +
  labs(x = "Site",
       y = "Hard Surface Area (%)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

```{r}
# On crée un index numérique pour l’axe x
Data_Globale_Tahiti <- Data_Globale_Tahiti %>%
  mutate(x_id = as.numeric(factor(Enr)))

# Dataset pour les rectangles de fond
communes_bg <- Data_Globale_Tahiti %>%
  group_by(Commune) %>%
  summarise(
    xmin = min(x_id) - 0.5,
    xmax = max(x_id) + 0.5
  )
# Coefficient pour mettre l'altitude à l'échelle des HSA
coef_alt <- max(Data_Globale_Tahiti$`HSA(%)`, na.rm = TRUE) /
            max(Data_Globale_Tahiti$`Alt(m)`, na.rm = TRUE)

ggplot() +
  # Fond coloré discret
  geom_rect(data = communes_bg,
            aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax,
                ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
                fill = Commune),
            alpha = 0.08) +
  
  # Barres HSA
  geom_col(data = Data_Globale_Tahiti,
           aes(x = x_id, y = `HSA(%)`),
           fill = "grey40") +
  
  # Points altitude (mis à l’échelle)
  geom_point(data = Data_Globale_Tahiti,
             aes(x = x_id, y = `Alt(m)` * coef_alt),
             shape = 4,              # croix
             color = "#E5989B",      # rouge pastel doux
             size = 2,
             stroke = 0.8,
             alpha = 0.8) +
  
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = Data_Globale_Tahiti$x_id,
    labels = Data_Globale_Tahiti$Enr
  ) +
  geom_line(data = Data_Globale_Tahiti,
          aes(x = x_id, y = `Alt(m)`* coef_alt, group = 1),
          color = "#E5989B",
          linewidth = 0.7) +
  
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "Hard Surface Area (%)",
    sec.axis = sec_axis(~ . / coef_alt,
                        name = "Altitude (m)")
  ) +
  
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Paired") +
  
  labs(x = "Site") +
  
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

```

```{r}
# On crée un index numérique pour l’axe x
Data_Globale_Tahiti <- Data_Globale_Tahiti %>%
  mutate(x_id = as.numeric(factor(Enr)))

# Dataset pour les rectangles de fond
communes_bg <- Data_Globale_Tahiti %>%
  group_by(Commune) %>%
  summarise(
    xmin = min(x_id) - 0.5,
    xmax = max(x_id) + 0.5
  )

# Format long pour empilement correct
Data_plot <- Data_Globale_Tahiti %>%
  mutate(
    S_Natif = S - S_Exo
  ) %>%
  select(x_id, Enr, S, S_Exo, S_Natif, `P/A_Myna`) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(S_Exo, S_Natif),
               names_to = "Type",
               values_to = "Richesse")

ggplot(Data_plot, aes(x = factor(x_id), y = Richesse, fill = Type)) +
  
  # Barres empilées
  geom_col(color = "black") +
  
  # Point Myna au sommet
  geom_point(data = Data_Globale_Tahiti %>%
               mutate(S_Natif = S - S_Exo) %>%
               filter(`P/A_Myna` == 1),
             aes(x = factor(x_id), 
                 y = S,
                 color = "Myna"),
             size = 3,
             inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  
  # Couleurs barres
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "S_Exo" = "#FCA5A5",
    "S_Natif" = "#BFE3C0"
  ),
  labels = c("Exotic", "Native"),
  name = "Type d'espèces") +
  
  # Couleur point
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Myna" = "#FFD700")) +
  
  scale_x_discrete(labels = Data_Globale_Tahiti$Enr) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = 0:y_max, limits = c(0, y_max)) +
  
  labs(x = "Site",
       y = "Species Richness") +
  
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "top")
```


```{r}
Data_long <- Data_Globale_Tahiti %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(`D_R_P(m)`, `D_M(m)`, `D_B(m)`),
    names_to = "Plage",
    values_to = "Distance"
  )

Data_long$Distance_km <- Data_long$Distance / 1000

ggplot(Data_long, aes(x = Enr, y = Distance_km, fill = Plage)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8)) +
  
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = seq(0, 7.5, by = 1)
  ) +
  
  coord_flip() +
  
  scale_fill_brewer(
  palette = "Pastel1",
  labels = c("Distance Building", "Distance Sea", "Distance Principal Road")
  ) +
  
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "grey80", linewidth = 0.5),
    legend.position = "top"
  ) +
  
  labs(
    x = "Site",
    y = "Distance (km)",
  )
```

Structure que l'on veut garder pour les analyses des différents habitats
```{r}
# Forcer l'ordre des habitats
Data_Globale_Tahiti$Hab <- factor(
  Data_Globale_Tahiti$Hab,
  levels = c("Urbain", "Suburbain", "Prairie", "Forêt")
)

# Graphique : boîte à moustaches + points + moyenne + SE
ggplot(Data_Globale_Tahiti,
       aes(x = Hab, y = `N/E`)) +
  
  # Boîte à moustaches
  geom_boxplot(
    fill = "grey80",
    alpha = 0.7,
    outlier.shape = NA
  ) +
  
  # Points par site
  geom_jitter(
    width = 0.15,
    alpha = 0.6,
    size = 2
  ) +
  
  # Moyenne
  stat_summary(
    fun = mean,
    geom = "point",
    shape = 18,
    size = 4,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  
  # Erreur standard (SE)
  stat_summary(
    fun.data = mean_se,
    geom = "errorbar",
    width = 0.2,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  
  labs(
    x = "Habitat",
    y = "Proportion d'espèces native (N/E)",
    title = "Proportion N/E par type d'habitat (sites, moyenne ± SE)"
  ) +
  
  theme_minimal()
library(emmeans)
mod_hab <-lmer(`N/E` ~ `Hab` + (1|Commune), data = Data_Globale_Tahiti)
summary(mod_hab)
car::Anova(mod_hab)
emmeans(mod_hab, pairwise ~ Hab)
emmeans(mod_hab, pairwise ~ Hab, adjust = "tukey")


```

```{r}
# Créer une nouvelle variable regroupant les habitats
Data_Globale_Tahiti <- Data_Globale_Tahiti %>%
  mutate(
    Habitat_Group = case_when(
      Hab %in% c("Urbain", "Suburbain") ~ "Urbain",
      Hab %in% c("Forêt", "Prairie") ~ "Nature",
      TRUE ~ Hab  # pour les autres éventuels
    )
  )

# Forcer l'ordre des groupes
Data_Globale_Tahiti$Habitat_Group <- factor(
  Data_Globale_Tahiti$Habitat_Group,
  levels = c("Urbain", "Nature")
)

# Graphique : boîte à moustaches + points + moyenne + SE
ggplot(Data_Globale_Tahiti,
       aes(x = Habitat_Group, y = `N/E`)) +
  
  # Boîte à moustaches
  geom_boxplot(
    fill = "grey80",
    alpha = 0.7,
    outlier.shape = NA
  ) +
  
  # Points par site
  geom_jitter(
    width = 0.15,
    alpha = 0.6,
    size = 2
  ) +
  
  # Moyenne
  stat_summary(
    fun = mean,
    geom = "point",
    shape = 18,
    size = 4,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  
  # Erreur standard (SE)
  stat_summary(
    fun.data = mean_se,
    geom = "errorbar",
    width = 0.2,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  
  labs(
    x = "Type d'habitat regroupé",
    y = "Proportion d'espèces native (N/E)",
    title = "Proportion N/E par habitat (Urbain vs Nature, sites, moyenne ± SE)"
  ) +
  
  theme_minimal()
summary(lm(`N/E` ~ `Habitat_Group`, data = Data_Globale_Tahiti))
```
```{r}
# Créer une variable pour 4 catégories de HSA
Data_Globale_Tahiti <- Data_Globale_Tahiti %>%
  mutate(
    HSA_Group = case_when(
      `HSA(%)` <= 0.10 ~ "≤ 10%",
      `HSA(%)` > 0.10 & `HSA(%)` <= 0.25 ~ "10–25%",
      `HSA(%)` > 0.25 & `HSA(%)` <= 0.50 ~ "25–50%",
      `HSA(%)` > 0.50 ~ "> 50%"
    )
  )

# Forcer l'ordre des catégories
Data_Globale_Tahiti$HSA_Group <- factor(
  Data_Globale_Tahiti$HSA_Group,
  levels = c("≤ 10%", "10–25%", "25–50%", "> 50%")
)

# Graphique : boîte à moustaches + points + moyenne + SE
ggplot(Data_Globale_Tahiti,
       aes(x = HSA_Group, y = `N/E`)) +
  
  # Boîte à moustaches
  geom_boxplot(
    fill = "grey80",
    alpha = 0.7,
    outlier.shape = NA
  ) +
  
  # Points par site
  geom_jitter(
    width = 0.15,
    alpha = 0.6,
    size = 2
  ) +
  
  # Moyenne
  stat_summary(
    fun = mean,
    geom = "point",
    shape = 18,
    size = 4,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  
  # Erreur standard (SE)
  stat_summary(
    fun.data = mean_se,
    geom = "errorbar",
    width = 0.2,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  
  labs(
    x = "Catégorie HSA (%)",
    y = "Proportion d'espèces native (N/E)",
    title = "Proportion N/E selon HSA (sites, moyenne ± SE)"
  ) +
  
  theme_minimal()

summary(lm(`N/E` ~ `HSA_Group`, data = Data_Globale_Tahiti))
```


```{r}
Data_Global_Long <- pivot_longer(Data_Globale_Tahiti,
                          cols = c(`Arb(%)`, `Arbu(%)`, `Her(%)`),
                          names_to = "Vegetation",
                          values_to = "Pourcentage")

# Calculer moyenne et écart-type par habitat
Richesse_Habitat <- Data_Globale_Tahiti %>%
  group_by(Hab) %>%
  summarise(S_mean = mean(S, na.rm = TRUE),
            S_sd = sd(S, na.rm = TRUE),
            S_Exo_mean = mean(S_Exo, na.rm = TRUE),
            S_Exo_sd = sd(S_Exo, na.rm = TRUE))

# Graph combiné
ggplot() +
  # Boxplots végétation
  geom_boxplot(data = Data_Global_Long,
               aes(x = Hab, y = Pourcentage, fill = Vegetation),
               position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
               outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(data = Data_Global_Long,
              aes(x = Hab, y = Pourcentage),
              position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.15),
              size = 1, alpha = 0.5, color = "grey20") +
  
  # Points pour richesse moyenne avec écart-type
  geom_point(data = Richesse_Habitat, 
             aes(x = Hab, y = S_mean * 10, color = "S_Total"), size = 3) +
  geom_errorbar(data = Richesse_Habitat,
                aes(x = Hab, ymin = (S_mean - S_sd) * 10, 
                    ymax = (S_mean + S_sd) * 10, color = "S_Total"), width = 0.2) +
  
  geom_point(data = Richesse_Habitat, 
             aes(x = Hab, y = S_Exo_mean * 10, color = "S_Exo"), size = 3) +
  geom_errorbar(data = Richesse_Habitat,
                aes(x = Hab, ymin = (S_Exo_mean - S_Exo_sd) * 10, 
                    ymax = (S_Exo_mean + S_Exo_sd) * 10, color = "S_Exo"), width = 0.2) +
  
  # Lignes reliant les points par type de richesse
  geom_line(data = Richesse_Habitat,
            aes(x = Hab, y = S_mean * 10, group = 1, color = "S_Total"), size = 1) +
  geom_line(data = Richesse_Habitat,
            aes(x = Hab, y = S_Exo_mean * 10, group = 1, color = "S_Exo"), size = 1) +
  
  # Couleurs
  scale_fill_grey(start = 0.3, end = 0.8,labels = c("Tree", "Shrub", "Grass")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("S_Total" = "#1f77b4", "S_Exo" = "#ff7f0e"), labels = c("Total Richness", "Exotic Richness"), name = "Richesse") +
  
  # Axe secondaire
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "Vegetation cover",
    limits = c(0, 100),
    sec.axis = sec_axis(~ ./10, name = "Species Richness", breaks = 1:10)
  ) +
  
  labs(x = "Habitat") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

```{r}
Data_Commune_Hab <- Data_Globale_Tahiti %>%
  group_by(Commune, Hab) %>%
  summarise(N_sites = n(), .groups = "drop")

ggplot(Data_Commune_Hab,
       aes(x = Commune, y = N_sites, fill = Hab)) +
  
  geom_col(position = "fill", color = "black") +
  
  # Ajout des effectifs dans les barres
  geom_text(aes(label = N_sites),
            position = position_fill(vjust = 0.5),
            color = "black",
            size = 4) +
  
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Forêt" = "#2E7D32",
    "Prairie" = "#FBC02D",
    "Suburbain" = "#1E88E5",
    "Urbain" = "#8D6E63"
  )) +
  
  labs(x = "Commune",
       y = "Number of Sites",
       fill = "Habitat") +
  
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

```{r}
Data_Globale_Tahiti <- Data_Globale_Tahiti %>%
  mutate(Habitat_group = case_when(
    Hab %in% c("Forêt", "Prairie") ~ "Naturel",
    Hab %in% c("Suburbain", "Urbain") ~ "Anthropisé"
  ))

Data_Commune_Hab <- Data_Globale_Tahiti %>%
  group_by(Commune, Habitat_group) %>%
  summarise(N_sites = n(), .groups = "drop")

ggplot(Data_Commune_Hab,
       aes(x = Commune, y = N_sites, fill = Habitat_group)) +
  
  geom_col(position = "fill", color = "black") +
  
  geom_text(aes(label = N_sites),
            position = position_fill(vjust = 0.5),
            size = 5) +
  
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Naturel" = "#2E7D32",
    "Anthropisé" = "#8D6E63"
  )) +
  
  labs(x = "Commune",
       y = "Proportion de sites",
       fill = "Type d'habitat") +
  
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```
